nodes.label: Moriarty Full-Roadmap Native Goal Design
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra

nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra

nodes.label: WebSocket In-Memory ZDR Continuation

nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra

nodes.label: Reuse Existing Native Goal
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.rationale: The native goal API only permits status changes, not objective editing. Do not recreate it, add Grok /loop, or treat a proposed revision as automatically active.

nodes.label: Grok 4.6 500,000-Token Context Window
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.rationale: Build configuration reference includes a one-million context example; exact Grok 4.6 documents 500,000 tokens. The example does not expand model capacity.

nodes.label: SWE-Marathon High 31.9% Card Observation
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.rationale: Benchmark observations are not Moriarty success probabilities. The card excludes unattended high-stakes financial decisions without oversight.

nodes.label: Grok Implementation Revision 01
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.rationale: Latest user instruction selects Grok 4.6 as implementation author with fresh Claude Opus and GPT-6 Astra medium as independent reviewers. This supersedes Terra-author/Grok-auditor routing while preserving acceptance, historical evidence, and resource gates.

nodes.label: Headless --worktree Does Not Create Isolation
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.rationale: The orchestrator must create/inspect the checkout before launch. Permission rules and prompt text cannot prove offline isolation.

nodes.label: SOURCES Claim: Headless --worktree Does Not Create a Worktree
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra

nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra

nodes.label: Exact 500k Context vs One-Million Example
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.rationale: The Build configuration reference one-million context example does not expand Grok 4.6's documented 500,000-token capacity.

nodes.label: dontAsk Is Not a Closed Allowlist
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.norm_label: dontask is not a closed allowlist
nodes.rationale: Built-in read-only approvals, merged/remembered rules and hooks can approve unmatched actions; Bash prefix matching after stripping env wrappers is not an exact argv restriction.

nodes.label: Descendant Quiescence Before Freeze
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.rationale: A parent process exit is insufficient; residual worker descendants can still mutate owned paths after timeout backgrounding.

nodes.label: Mandatory Pre-Dispatch Control Gate
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.rationale: Specified-only until root records sanitized configuration, negative denied-path checks, and child-process secret/network boundaries. A design verdict or positive fixture cannot waive it. --sandbox strict alone cannot satisfy the gate because setup failure can continue unenforced.

nodes.label: Headless Grok CLI Launch Template
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.rationale: Use --prompt-file or --single, not positional input; pin grok-4.6 high, --no-plan, scoped allow/deny, and --output-format json. Template is not dispatch-ready until the control gate passes.

nodes.label: Requested grok-4.6 vs Returned grok-4.6-build
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.rationale: Empirical request/return mapping from the corrected --single canary; no inspected official source pins the internal suffix to an immutable checkpoint.

nodes.label: Positional Input Is Interactive
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.rationale: The first native-JSON canary failed with a device error on positional input; --single returned READY and end_turn in 3.799 seconds.

nodes.label: SP05 Loan Exit-Retention Repair
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.rationale: FINANCIAL_COMPLETE cannot establish raw main exit zero; retain loaded/exited evidence before stop and reject unloaded, default, mismatched, or post-stop observations.

nodes.label: SP05 Exit-Retention Public Predicate
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.rationale: Preserve startup InvocationID; require matching InvocationID, MainPID=0, Result=success, ExecMainCode=1 and ExecMainStatus=0; FINANCIAL_COMPLETE alone cannot establish exit zero.

nodes.label: Dedicated --leader-socket Executor
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.rationale: Never adopt an unbound shared leader or terminate unrelated users' leader processes; prefer documented non-off sandbox in-process routing while verifying mode and enforcement separately.

nodes.label: Actual Executor Binding
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.rationale: Revision-02 Opus identified a blocking shared-leader gap. Bind executor mode/socket/PID/executable/version/hash/cgroup before and after and fail closed when binding is unavailable.

nodes.label: Source-Only Default Without Proven Child Filtering
nodes.author: GPT-6 Astra
nodes.norm_label: source-only default without proven child filtering
nodes.rationale: Absent pre-existing effective child-environment filtering verified in the receipt, source-only/no-shell is the default; the shipped default inherits the full environment.

nodes.label: moriarty-financial-expression-source/1
nodes.rationale: Approved CLI candidate checks the published vault quote with the same source-only static result as its public API; formatter re-checks and is idempotent. Source-only checking and formatting do not establish a financial transition, source-defined financial schema, simulation, K correspondence, proof, wallet, native, or Midnight Preview behavior.

nodes.label: createFinancialExpressionContractV1
nodes.rationale: Old runtime exposes no extension seam, so two new versioned modules contain an explicit checked-machine/type-system adaptation and reuse the unchanged canonical wire module. There are no host callbacks or caller-provided semantics.

nodes.label: simulate Command
nodes.rationale: Local only: does not compile or run K, establish a proof correspondence, execute a financial operation, or access a ledger, wallet, network, or service. Wrapper never emits tentative candidate state or descriptors on rejection.

nodes.label: VaultConversion 56-Node Body
nodes.rationale: Positive supply and valuation are two explicit Require expressions preceding the unchanged body; the unguarded body does not independently enforce that domain. Empty financial collections are typed source fixtures, not validated financial states.

nodes.label: Financial Named-Type Limit of 256
nodes.rationale: Copied financial-schema.md:111-120 limits named record/enum/variant types to 256 while retaining simultaneous 65536-byte, 4096-JSON-node and depth-64 whole-schema bounds. This differs from the old profile's 256 total declarations; the new profile follows the financial clause and the old profile stays unchanged.

nodes.label: NetAmount Symmetric UInt128 Difference

nodes.label: ARITH Exact Overloads

nodes.label: Head-Only Evaluation Context Structure

nodes.rationale: On-curve cost is not subgroup membership. When identity is true the on-curve gate asserts nothing; host (0,0,true) assignments do not constrain external encoding.

nodes.label: Canonical Identity Packing
nodes.rationale: Subgroup identity acceptance alone does not enforce the canonical identity used by the host transcript. Circuit point type allows arbitrary x/y when is_id; as_public_input exports those coordinates without masking.

nodes.label: IvcInstance Wire-Interface Obligation
nodes.rationale: MSM public encoding does not serialize structural labels needed to reconstruct the MSM. A flat Fq vector cannot be treated as a self-describing carried accumulator. No canonical standalone byte decoder for IvcInstance was found.

nodes.label: Seven-Limb Foreign-Field Representation
nodes.rationale: Assigned representation uses shift 1 + sum(limb[i] * base^i) modulo Fp with base 2^56. A one-scalar coordinate cast cannot replace the foreign-field representation because 0 and Fq.modulus both reduce to scalar zero.

nodes.label: Unresolved Subgroup Proof Obligation
nodes.rationale: Native variable-base assignment omits subgroup checks, and the cofactor-root helper uses an incomplete-addition justification whose prime-order premise is not established for an arbitrary on-curve root. This is an unresolved proof obligation, not a demonstrated exploit.

nodes.label: Arithmetic-Region Height 9,112,880
nodes.rationale: Conservative unoptimized construction: 88480 Fp products times 45 plus 91630 normalizations times 56. Not a complete finalizer/verifier row bound, measured circuit, minimum row requirement, or evidence that any particular k fits.

nodes.label: Complete Addition Relation
nodes.rationale: Specifies [r]P=O without first assuming P has prime order. Inverse witness never needs an unconstrained host exception: denominator is nonzero by construction via safeD selection.

nodes.label: Literal Integer r Double-and-Add Schedule
nodes.rationale: Uses the exact positive integer r from the pinned Fq modulus, not a value constructed in Fq, which would produce zero and turn [r]P=O into a vacuous scalar-zero calculation. 254 doubles plus 133 adds equals 387 complete-add calls.

nodes.label: Cofactor-Root Incomplete-Addition Obligation
nodes.rationale: mul_by_u128 incomplete-addition argument assumes every nonidentity input has order r, but the cofactor-root entry only establishes on-curve membership. Honest root generation inside the prime-order subgroup does not settle it.

nodes.label: F0a Finalizer No-Go
nodes.rationale: Missing bound is the total constrained cost of the complete pairing predicate in an exact outer stack. Fit result is unknown, therefore no-go under the current F0 rule. This is an engineering evidence gap, not a proof that the route is impossible. No backend choice or resource allocation is approved.

nodes.label: Final-Exponentiation 3E Identity Predicate
nodes.rationale: Host chain computes exponent 3E where E=(p^12-1)/r, modulo p^12-1, not the same target-group value as exponent E. For a nonzero extension-field element both give the same identity test because gcd(3,r)=1. This is an algebraic identity-predicate observation, not verification of a native pairing fixture.

nodes.label: Narration Register

nodes.label: No Hedging
